notes: Nembo hubadilika pamoja na maneno: simu iliyohamishwa kwenda ofisi nyingine ikiwa imefungwa sasa huchora nembo ya ofisi mpya kwenye skrini iliyofungwa mara moja, bila kufunguliwa na kufungwa tena. / The mark changes with the words: a handset shifted to the other office while locked now draws the new office's logo on the locked screen at once, without an unlock-and-relock.
